card.name: Second number in small ranges
card.fires_on: The small number word (two, three, four) that closes a range after "one or" or "two to", and the "-two" in "one-two punch". It is common in dosing and duration phrases.

modes.label: Range of small counts
modes.description: A number word completing a range like "one or two" or "two to four", often for doses, days or weeks.
modes.example: Instill one drop into the conjunctival sac two to<< four>> times daily.

modes.description: The "-two" in the idiom "one-two punch" in general web text.
